instruction:
Reconstruct the final tower described by these successive speech messages from one trial. Later messages can correct earlier ones. A correction that depends on an unseen Builder state may remain ambiguous.

Message 1: Is it recording? Yeah, okay. So you want to take a green block and place it here with the short side facing you. So you're placing it on the right hand side of the grid with the short end facing you. And then you take a red block and you place it on top of the green block in the bottom right grid. So on top of it here. And then on top of that red block you place another green block with the short side facing you in the same orientation at the bottom. So you kind of have like an E shape like this on the right hand side of your grid.

assumptions: "short side facing you" for a green block (2x1x4 or 4x1x2) means its 2-unit dimension is along the z-axis, implying the block is oriented with axis=x (4,1,2).
The first green block, being 4 units long, is placed at x=0, z=2 to cover the entire front row, satisfying "on the right hand side of the grid" by covering the right-front cell.
The second green block is centered on the red block below it.
The final description of an "E shape" is a loose characterization for the resulting I-like stack, as the specific instructions and block count do not form a typical E.

And then you take a red block and you place it on top of the green block in the bottom right grid.
